name: Stolen Blasting Powder
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.
narrative.objectives: Recover 16 Stolen Blasting Powder from the troggs east of Gol'Bolar Quarry, then return to Quarrymaster Thesten.
narrative.offerRewardText: That should be all the stolen powder. Thank you, champion.Please accept this reward, and... I'd appreciate if you didn't mention this little incident to anyone.
narrative.requestItemsText: I hope you've got good news for me?
